name: CO2
source:
Year 30XX AD.
Humans colonize space and genetically create many new life forms. Towns with forests and clean air are covered with domes due to heavy environment pollution.
Main heroine is a student who is going to home town for summer vacations. But school main computer breaks down, and as a result barrier with the outside world is going to vanish in three days. Only two more students stay at this time at school. Will they succeed in preventing the disaster in three days time?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
公元30XX年。
人类殖民太空并通过基因创造了许多新的生命形式。那些有森林、空气清新的城镇，由于环境污染严重，被穹顶覆盖。
女主角是一名即将回家乡过暑假的学生。但学校的主机坏了，三天后与外界的障碍就会消失。此时只剩下两名学生留在学校。三天后他们能成功阻止灾难吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
